name: Pickup
description: A bubble of pulp bursting against the mouth: one sine dropping from $tonic to $third.down in 45ms, a pop rather than a beep. It fires in streams — a magnet pulls a whole field in at once — so it ships three takes the engine turns through, all the same pop from bubbles a little bigger or smaller than each other, with a narrow pitch roll on top: enough that sixty in a row are many bubbles and not one played sixty times, not so much that they stop being the same sound. No more than a dozen of it a second. The takes are written by hand rather than with `takes`, because a pure tone has nothing to reseed; they carry the `take-N` names so the engine round-robins them all the same.

take-2.description: The same pop from a slightly bigger bubble: a little lower, a little longer.

take-3.description: The same pop from a slightly smaller bubble: a little higher, a little shorter.
